usedFor: BrowserAct runs saved browser jobs, started with “Run Task From Template” or “Run Workflow Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Run Task From Template” in BrowserAct
bestTemplate.why: It starts a task you saved, so a repeated web chore runs the same way each time.

watchOut: “Run Workflow Task” needs a workflow ID, so copy it from BrowserAct before you build the step.
